test_inputs.explanation: The agent repeatedly navigated to the Magento admin sales order page (http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/sales_order/). Based on the tool's schema for filtering orders, I've provided realistic test values that would work with a typical Magento installation: a common order ID format (100000001), 'Processing' status (most common order state), date range covering 2024, sample customer names, and reasonable price ranges for testing order filtering functionality.
